classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In the measure loop the rank itself calls probe.read_staged on the class_a path and times it as 'gated' stall before probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s), so it waits on that single read of each file with no barrier holding other ranks.

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b items are read once each by the separate _prefetch process feeding a depth-8 multiprocessing.Queue, so the reads overlap the main loop's compute sleep rather than being awaited by any rank.
